domains.name: Supplier Onboarding & Data Management
objectives: Explain the steps and best practices involved in onboarding a new supplier, including duplicate checks, profile and banking data collection, and activation.
Describe how supplier data (profiles, locations, banking details) is imported, validated, and managed within the ServiceNow Supplier Lifecycle Operations platform.

domains.name: Supplier Collaboration, Workspace, Case & Task Management
objectives: Summarize the key features of the Supplier Collaboration Portal that support supplier self-service.
Distinguish between supplier cases and tasks within the Supplier Lifecycle Operations framework.

domains.name: Supplier Relationship, Performance & Risk Management
objectives: Explain how supplier performance is monitored and managed using KPIs, segmentation rules, and dashboards in ServiceNow.
Describe how Supplier Lifecycle Operations integrates with Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) to support risk assessments and due diligence throughout the supplier lifecycle.

domains.name: Integrations & Advanced Work Assignments
objectives: Describe the role of integrations (Craft.co, ERP, News, Google Maps) in enhancing supplier intelligence and operational efficiency.
